title: Writing / Style / Semicolons
slide_intent: Break complex thoughts into simpler sentences so conversational copy is easier to follow.
strategic_value: Preferring short sentences can help Duolingo maintain the approachable rhythm shown in its writing examples.
demonstration: Two accepted versions use a full stop or em dash; the rejected version joins the clauses with a semicolon.
practical_value: Split a two-part sentence when possible, using an em dash only as the secondary option.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the topic heading, its parent label and the written convention in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Place the worked copy in the pale right panel, keeping preference labels and green checks with their examples.

reference_purposes.Application: A dog-greeting example is shown as two sentences, with an em dash and with a rejected semicolon.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Replace semicolons with an em dash or, preferably, two simple sentences.
